description: This Java class, CustomerOptionPopulator, is responsible for converting or populating CustomerOption data transfer objects from core business models, specifically for customer options related to a merchant store in an e-commerce system. It extends an abstract data populator and manages the transfer of customer option data including its values, with support for localization via language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts CustomerOption core model objects into CustomerOption web entity objects, adding locale-specific information and option values.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a core CustomerOption object into an API/web entity CustomerOption, populating its properties and associated values, potentially throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: A placeholder method to create a new CustomerOption object as the target for population.

methods.name: getOptionSet
methods.description: Returns the currently set CustomerOptionSet instance.

methods.name: setOptionSet
methods.description: Assigns a CustomerOptionSet to this populator for use in population.
